headline: Best Buy beats on gaming, computing and phones; domestic comps +1.8% while appliances slump; guidance held.
guidance_note: Reiterated FY27 revenue $41.2-42.1B, comps -1% to +1%, adj EPS $6.30-6.60; Q2 comp guided ~+1% while lapping last June's gaming launch.
key_messages: Domestic comp +1.8% (vs -0.7% a year ago); enterprise comp +2.0%, revenue $8.94B, adj EPS $1.28 up 11%.
Gaming, computing, mobile phones and services led; major appliances fell sharply (appliance comps reported down ~13.6%).
May month-to-date comps ran up high single digits, but Q2 guided ~+1% against a ~$200M gaming-launch comparison.
Management sees no material memory-related inventory supply constraints for the rest of FY27.
CEO Corie Barry to step down; Jason Bonfig takes over Nov. 1, 2026.

consumer.big_ticket: Tech categories (gaming, computing, phones) grew, but big-ticket major appliances declined sharply.

macro_read: Consumer-tech demand is stabilizing on product cycles, but appliance weakness points to a still-sluggish housing market; shoppers remain deal-driven.
